name: Empowering Tincture brews with Manaroot + Herb, then On Enter draws into memory
notes: Empowering Tincture's element is NORM, so no lineage patch is needed. Brewing is an alternate cost declared via a YESNO decision at materialize time; its recipe requires exactly one Manaroot plus one other Herb, so both tokens are seeded onto the field and selected in that order (Manaroot first, matching the CARD-slot-before-HERB-slot ordering in FlattenBrewSlots). Only the On Enter 'if brewed, draw into memory' half is covered; the unconditional Sacrifice: +2 level effect is out of scope.

rulesClauses: On Enter: If Empowering Tincture was brewed, draw a card into your memory.
